configuration.title: OpenClaw
configuration.gatewayUrl.description: Gateway service URL used when connecting through the OpenClaw HTTP/WebSocket gateway.
configuration.gatewayToken.description: Optional authentication token for the configured OpenClaw gateway.
configuration.configMode.description: Choose how the extension resolves agents and chats: auto-detect, OpenClaw CLI, gateway, or local config files.
configuration.authProfilesPath.descripti: Optional path to the OpenClaw auth profiles file used in local mode.
configuration.modelsPath.description: Optional path to the models definition file used in local mode.
configuration.stateDir.description: Optional override for the OpenClaw state directory. Leave empty to auto-detect the current machine setup.
configuration.memoryBackend.description: Memory storage backend for Luna/OpenClaw persistence.
configuration.memoryRoot.description: Optional override for the memory storage root (local backend).
configuration.memoryWebDavUrl.descriptio: WebDAV base URL for the memory storage backend.
configuration.skillHubs.description: Optional list of remote skill hubs to use for the Skill Market.
configuration.skillHubs.name: Display name for the hub.
configuration.cliPath.description: Optional override for the OpenClaw CLI executable or entry file. Leave empty to auto-detect common install locations.
configuration.nodePath.description: Optional override for the Node.js executable used to launch OpenClaw CLI when auto-detection is not enough.
configuration.defaultAgent.description: Preferred default agent ID to select when opening the panel.
configuration.timeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds for network or provider operations.
configuration.streamResponse.description: Stream assistant responses in the chat panel when supported.
configuration.showTokenCount.description: Show token counts for assistant responses when available.
configuration.codeTheme.description: Preferred code block theme in the chat panel.
configuration.enableMetrics.description: Collect and display usage metrics in the sidebar and panel.
